title: Paradise Reserve | Luxe Pool, GolfSim & Pickleball
description:
Private ultra-luxury 1-acre Scottsdale estate, sleeps 16 across 6 bedrooms. 
6BR (including 2x Master suites)
Private bathroom for each bedroom

Pool with waterfall + hot tub, golf simulator, pickleball court, putting green, and full gym. 
Chef's kitchen, custom bar, wine cellar, covered patios with fireplace. 

10 min to Old Town, 12 min to TPC Scottsdale. 

Perfect for golf trips, corporate retreats, or family reunions. Book your private resort today.

 The space 
WHAT MAKES THIS PLACE SPECIAL
- Private 1+ acre estate in the heart of Scottsdale, a true resort-style retreat, not just a house
- 5,550 sq ft of designer-inspired, newly refinished interiors
- Purpose-built for groups: corporate masterminds, wellness retreats, golf trips, multi-generational family gatherings, and milestone celebrations
- Smart home features throughout for effortless control of lighting, entertainment, and climate

AT A GLANCE
- Sleeps 16 guests
- 6 bedrooms / 5.5 bathrooms
- 5,550 square feet
- Over 1 acre of private desert landscape
- Multiple indoor/ outdoor gathering spaces
- Discount available for 7+ night stays

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
- Bedroom 1 (Primary Suite): King bed, private en-suite bathroom (dual sink, walk-in shower, bathtub), walk-in-closet, bar fridge, outdoor shower
- Bedroom 2: King bed, private en-suite bathroom, walk-in-closet
- Bedroom 3: King bed, private en-suite bathroom, walk-in-closet
- Bedroom 4: King bed, private en-suite bathroom, walk-in-closet
- Bedroom 5 (Casita Master Suite): King bed, private en-suite bathroom (dual sink, walk-in shower)
- Bedroom 6 (Casita): Two bunk beds (Singles-over queens, sleeps 6)
- Ideal for groups wanting privacy - 5 of 6 bedrooms have their own en-suite bath

OUTDOOR LIVING AND AMENITIES
- Resort-style pool with dramatic overhead waterfall, selectable LED lights
- Adjoining hot tub
- Optional pool heating ($200/day, 3-day minimum), recommended October through May
- Covered patio with fireplace and mounted TV for shaded lounging
- Built-in BBQ, sink area, with outdoor bar seating for 6 & outdoor TV
- Outdoor dining area, seats 8
- Private putting green
- Pickleball court
- Outdoor Movie theatre screen and projector
- Driveway parking for 6-8 vehicles
- Lush, mature desert landscaping throughout the grounds
- Outdoor shower (adjacent to the primary suite)

INDOOR FEATURES
- State-of-the-art golf simulator, play iconic courses without leaving the property
- Spacious great room with sitting area and TV
- Open-concept chef's kitchen with massive island and custom bar
- Formal dining room, suited for group meals or business meetings
- Multiple AC zones throughout the house
- Temperature-controlled wine cellar
- Fully equipped gym: Peloton, Smith machine, dumbbells, kettlebells, incline bench, yoga equipment
- Large flat-screen TVs throughout the home
- Dedicated workspace for remote work between activities
- High-speed WiFi 7 (1 Gbps) throughout
- Designer-inspired, modern interiors with high-end finishes

KITCHEN AND DINING
- Full-size chef's kitchen with premium appliances
- Massive center island with bar seating
- Custom bar area overlooking the backyard
- Formal dining room for group meals
- Outdoor dining for 8 additional guests
- Coffee maker, espresso machine, multiple dishwashers, double oven, multiple refrigerators, stove, toaster, blender, and full cookware/utensil set
- Butler's kitchen with additional full-size refrigerator (mini & craft ice maker), and dishwasher

LOCATION AND PROXIMITY
- 10 minutes to vibrant Old Town Scottsdale (dining, nightlife, shopping)
- 12 minutes to TPC Scottsdale, home of the annual WM Phoenix Open
- 10 minutes to Scottsdale Airport
- 20 minutes to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport
- Close to championship golf courses, hiking trails, and top-rated restaurants

POLICIES AND PRACTICAL INFORMATION
- Check-in: 4:00 PM / Check-out: 10:00 AM
- Early/late check-in or check-out may be available for a fee, subject to approval within 48 hours of arrival
- Minimum age requirements apply for the booking guest
- All guest names required at booking
- $1,000 fee applies for evidence of unauthorized gatherings, parties, or unapproved guests
- $250+ cleaning fee applies if property is left in poor condition
- Reservations require both booking and deposit, dates are not held on verbal request alone
- Additional verification may apply for bookings made within 72 hours of arrival or for local Arizona-based guests

CITY AND SHORT-TERM RENTAL COMPLIANCE
- Noise ordinances strictly enforced, no unauthorized parties or gatherings
- TPT #21648655
- Short-Term Rental Permit #2023-2043278

SAFETY FEATURES
- Carbon monoxide detectors
- Smoke detectors
- Fire extinguishers
- First aid kit

 Guest access 
Guests can use the entire property and all amenities.
Guest parking in driveways only.
One single garage is for owner use only.
Owners storage is locked near the kitchen.
